eve: quick flag 10: we got an unassigned spike after the enrichment job this morning. SLA alerts firing. anyone online? :eyes:
sam: on it. traces show many enrich calls returning after rr slot expiry. looks like TTL too short vs occasional backend blip.
marta: we cut ttl to 20s last week to reduce latency; tradeoff is fragility on bursts.
hubspot-bot: metric.alert: inbound.handoff.unassigned_rate=6.3% window=10m source=hs-sync
bryan: short patch idea: enable a tiny staging window (60s) that holds leads and retries enrich once after 8s, tag as pending_enrich and exclude from sequences for 30m. fallback to overflow if still missing.
eve: love minimal blast radius. propose canary 3% for 20m, metrics: staging_count, unassigned_rate, assign_latency_p95. rollback if unassigned > baseline*1.8.
sam: config snippet (canary 3%):
```
router.handoff.staging_enabled=true
router.handoff.staging_ttl_s=60
router.handoff.retry_after_s=8
router.handoff.defer_owner_write=true
canary.percent=3
```
marta: I'll update the HS/SF mapping doc to avoid owner writes while pending_enrich=true. also add a saved filter to monitor affected leads.
bryan: I'll add heartbeat delta metric and a short playbook for ops.
eve: owners: marta=docs+filters, sam=deploy+canary, bryan=telemetry+playbook, me=CSM comms. start canary in 25m. ping here with deltas. :rocket:
